notes: SR88 Oliver Bonas Home (oliverbonas.com/homeware). Site is Angular-Universal SSR on Magento; server only fully prerenders for a bot-identified User-Agent (default curl/python UA matches the site's own crawlerUserAgent allowlist embedded in dfConfig, which explicitly includes '^curl'); a spoofed desktop-Chrome UA gets only the client app-shell. Used default curl UA for tier-1 SSR fetches, then Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) only where the SSR HTML rendered 'See all items' with no number (JS-hydrated count). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only disallows /basket /checkout /account /search /wishlist (site's own search box is therefore off-limits to crawl - relied on main nav, footer, and sitemap.xml instead). Checked sitemap.xml (grep for bestsell*/popular/trending/favourite/top-sell terms) plus main nav and footer. Found the genuine homeware-scoped Bestsellers PLP at /homeware/category/bestsellers ('Homeware Bestsellers'), same URL family as the site's other homeware category pages (breadcrumb-free but titled distinctly, filters/sort present, real product grid, confirmed via both SSR text 'See all 71 items' and live-DOM header 'Homeware Bestsellers 71 styles' - two independent renders agree exactly, no flag needed). Also found a second, DIFFERENT Bestsellers listing at /new-in/best-sellers ('Most Wanted | Bestsellers', H1 'Bestsellers', live count '146 styles' sitewide) - opened and confirmed real via Filters modal Department facet breakdown: Home (58) Fashion (7) Jewellery (21) Accessories (29) Gift (5) Beauty (16) Furniture (10). This is genuinely a different, larger, sitewide bestsellers concept (146 vs 71, different URL, different scope) but it is NOT homeware-specific (only 58/146 tagged Home) and has no isolable homeware-only sub-URL to crawl separately (selecting the Home facet did not change the URL to a bookmarkable link) - excluded per the same 'drop mixed navigational roll-ups without a decor-only sub-URL' precedent used on this company's prior Home-Decor pass, rather than padding with a mixed-department row. No sub-structure (Bestsellers>X) found under /homeware/category/bestsellers itself - the category links shown on that page (Wall Art, Glassware, Lighting, Vases, Plant Pots, Photo Frames) are the standard homeware quick-nav sidebar, not bestseller-specific child listings, and were not treated as such.

rows.evidence: SSR HTML filter-modal button text: 'See all 71 items'; independently confirmed by live-rendered page header 'Homeware Bestsellers 71 styles' via Claude-in-Chrome
